what: The validator's naming-convention rule reports whitespace in any name attribute as an error. On CADAssembly, CADPart and CADFace the X3D 4.0 object model types name as a plain SFString label, and the X3D 4.0 schema accepts the file.
object_model: x3d_mcp fa4a8e3, src/validation/schemas/X3dUnifiedObjectModel-4.0.xml: CADAssembly, CADPart, CADFace, CADLayer name = SFString, no simpleType; HAnimJoint name = SFString with baseType xs:NMTOKEN
what_we_did: Shipped scenes use names without spaces (BC1_body, CourtCanopyTruss); the spaced original is kept in controls/ so the count can be reproduced. IFC names with spaces (Column -4/1) travel as MetadataString values, which the rule does not read.
grade: Confirmed that the rule and the object model disagree; Likely that the rule is the one to change (an authoring hint may still prefer plain tokens)
